params.command: $tasks=@(); try{$tasks=@(Get-ScheduledTask | ForEach-Object { $t=$_; foreach($a in @($t.Actions)){ $s=([string]$a.Execute+' '+[string]$a.Arguments); if($s -match 'localtunnel|--port\s+7443'){ [pscustomobject]@{TaskName=$t.TaskName;TaskPath=$t.TaskPath;State=[string]$t.State;Execute=[string]$a.Execute;Arguments=[string]$a.Arguments} } } })}catch{}; $startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup'); $startupHits=@(); if(Test-Path $startup){ foreach($f in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $startup -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ try{$txt=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction Stop; if(($f.Name+' '+$txt) -match 'localtunnel|--port\s+7443'){ $startupHits += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$f.FullName;Content=$txt} }}catch{} } }; $runHits=@(); foreach($rk in @('HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run','HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run')){ if(Test-Path $rk){ $o=Get-ItemProperty $rk; foreach($p in $o.PSObject.Properties){ if($p.Name -notmatch '^PS' -and ([string]$p.Value) -match 'localtunnel|--port\s+7443'){ $runHits += [pscustomobject]@{Registry=$rk;Name=$p.Name;Value=[string]$p.Value} } } } }; $parents=@(80988,106432 | ForEach-Object { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$_) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine }); [ordered]@{scheduled_tasks=$tasks;startup=$startupHits;run_registry=$runHits;former_parents=$parents}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
